content: Cefditoren pivoxil tablets, marketed under the brand name SPECTRACEF®, are available in two dosage strengths: 200 mg and 400 mg. These tablets are white, elliptical, film-coated, and are imprinted with “CBP 200” or “CBP 400” in blue ink, depending on the dosage strength. The 400 mg tablets are supplied in the following blister pack configurations: NDC 10122-802-20: 20-count blister pack. NDC 10122-802-28: 28-count blister pack. NDC 10122-802-02: 2-count blister pack. The 200 mg tablets are supplied in the following blister pack configuration: NDC 10122-801-20: 20-count blister pack. For storage, the tablets should be kept at a controlled room temperature of 25°C (77°F), with permissible temperature excursions ranging from 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F). The product must be protected from light and moisture. It should be dispensed in a tight, light-resistant container to maintain its stability and efficacy. Healthcare professionals seeking additional information about this product can contact the Cornerstone Therapeutics Medical Information Line at 1-888-661-9260.
